Name: Comically Large Spoon
Author: EchoHarbor
Description:
I had a dream for a comically large spoon to whack slimes with in Stardew Valley. 

I have made this as comically large spoon as large as the game allows (unless I'm mistaken)

The spoon will most likely whack slimes. 

It can be bought from Marlon :)

The spoon itself Is now droppable through slimes! Whack the slimes! Do it! 
----------------------------------

Made for a friend who just manually installed over 600 mods so I thought I'd give him one more :D 

Requirements - Just to cover all bases
SMAPI
Json Assets
Content patcher 
SpaceCore
Expanded Preconditions Utility
------------------
OPTIONAL BUT IMPORTANT

If you want it to be droppable - install ExtendedLootTables.


This somehow took 5 hours to make 1.0
